source.description: Controlled demonstration dataset of synthetic Indian Standards for platform validation. (DEMO / SYNTHETIC DATA)

standards.title: Stationary Electric Water Storage Heaters Safety Specification (DEMO / SYNTHETIC DATA)
standards.scope: Specification covering constructional, electrical safety, insulation resistance, and pressurized hydrostatic burst requirements for household electric water heaters.
standards.description: Synthetic compliance benchmark for electric water heating vessels up to 250V AC. Clearly marked as DEMO / SYNTHETIC DATA.

requirements.title: Dielectric Insulation Withstand Voltage
requirements.description: The insulation between live conductor pins and accessible ground chassis shall withstand a test potential of 1500V RMS at 50Hz for not less than 60 seconds without dielectric puncture or flashover.
requirements.verification_method: High-potential dielectric withstand test apparatus 1500V RMS

requirements.title: Hydrostatic Pressure Containment
requirements.description: The water storage container vessel shall sustain a continuous hydraulic pressure of 1.2 MPa for 15 minutes without permanent deformation, seam rupture, or measurable leakage.
requirements.verification_method: Hydrostatic pressure test bench with calibrated digital gauge

requirements.title: Thermal Cutout & Pressure Relief Overpressure Protection
requirements.description: An independent non-self-resetting thermal limiter shall disconnect all ungrounded conductors before water vessel temperature reaches 95 degrees Celsius.

requirements.title: Mandatory Conformity Marking & Rating Plate
requirements.description: Every heater shall bear a legible, indelible rating label displaying rated voltage, wattage, rated capacity in litres, operating pressure, and country of origin.
requirements.verification_method: Visual inspection and rubbing test with water and petroleum spirit for 15s

standards.title: Lithium-Ion Energy Storage Battery Pack Safety Criteria (DEMO / SYNTHETIC DATA)
standards.scope: Comprehensive safety requirements for secondary lithium battery packs used in consumer electronic devices and light electric vehicles.
standards.description: Synthetic benchmark for battery thermal stability, short circuit protection, and cell overcharge prevention. (DEMO / SYNTHETIC DATA)

requirements.title: External Direct Short Circuit Protection
requirements.description: The fully charged battery pack shall be subjected to an external short-circuit resistance of less than 5 milliohms at 55 degrees Celsius. The internal BMS shall trip within 50 milliseconds without explosion or thermal runaway.
requirements.verification_method: High-current external short circuit test rig in explosion-resistant chamber

requirements.title: Overcharge Current and Voltage Limiting
requirements.description: Charging shall be continued at 2.0 times rated current until the protective circuit terminates charging or the cell temperature reaches steady state without rupture or fire.
requirements.verification_method: Programmable DC power supply with thermal thermocouple logging

requirements.title: Drop and Mechanical Shock Resistance
requirements.description: The pack shall be dropped from a height of 1.0 meter onto concrete surface on each of its 6 faces without cell leakage, flame, or loss of protective insulation.
